node_definition.done_when: Read section 10 of dependency-edge-semantics first. A decision record gains optional recommended and recommended_by fields, stored in the plan HTML and returned by read_plan. A new edit_plan op, accept, sets the decision's choice from its recommendation in one action, recording when and by whom. An unanswered recommendation never becomes the choice: the decision stays open and blocking. Writing a decision scoped to a section the plan does not declare is refused at write time, naming the section and the declared ones. The roadmap reports an existing scoped decision whose section is undeclared as a finding. For a plan held only by a section-scoped open decision, is_blocked in reckon/roadmap.py and its persisted-blocked fallback agree. Each item has a test in tests/test_decision_recommendation_and_scope.py that fails at the base, built on a temporary docs tree. Run `date -u` first and treat that instant as your start; your deadline is 60 minutes later. Write your manifest before starting any long command. Run both gate arms with pytest-xdist (-n 8 --timeout=300), never serially. Run the base arm, from a `git archive` extraction of your base under /tmp in a directory named for this run, and then the head arm, each in the foreground: a background command dies when your turn ends. Keep the gate to the test files that reach your change, tens of files rather than hundreds. Each arm uses its own basetemp outside any repository and writes to its own new log path, which it never overwrites. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder. Each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed Python paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: Let a decision carry a recommendation the lead accepts, and check a section-scoped decision against the plan's sections, as dependency-edge-semantics §10 states.
